correctness.rationale: Distinct frequency lags 0,1,2 are exactly extracted for N>=6. The zero-lag circulant invertibility recovers every reference modulus and rules out zero competitors. The nonzero lag-two products force exactly two unit parity factors. Lag one uniquely determines any nonglobal factor and yields the recurrence r_{t+2}=κ²r_t, with modulus constraints and periodicity giving κ^N=1 and ρ^m=1. The given chirp form is both necessary and sufficient by direct substitution; a separate exact integer group-ring checker verifies explicit family examples in 18 even dimensions, without substituting for the proof.

originality.rationale: Primary full text of Bartusel 2023 develops ambiguity-support sufficient conditions and separated-support results, rather than a full-support complete fiber at one resonant lag-one Fourier zero; its generic conclusions do not imply a classification of exceptional chirped signals. The full 2026 follow-up treats denser support sufficient sampling. Two full relevant published-finding corpus proofs concern odd-dimensional endpoint recovery and even-dimensional two-point windows respectively, neither covering this even-order three-tap resonance. An earlier equal-tap case restricts to odd half-length and no phase-twisted endpoints. All these are statement-and-implication comparisons; an unindexed prior derivation remains a risk.

value.rationale: A complete deterministic exception set for a natural minimal cyclic three-tap spectrogram closes the gap between generic identifiability and full-support injectivity. Unlike a routine isolated example, the theorem proves a universal sharp fiber bound, exact algebraic equality family, and chirped counterexamples across every even dimension for strictly dominant middle tap, with direct relevance to reliability of STFT inversion.
